notes: Spring Grove Avenue: the 100 ft avenue across the top-left corner has no name printed inside this strip; name assumed. Railroad Avenue: read from widely spaced lettering RAILROAD (near 7700,1130) ... AVENUE (near 9300,310) on the 50 ft street along the north side of the tracks. Beech/Railroad Avenue: Beech Avenue crosses the tracks obliquely to its southern leg. Ludlow Avenue (north of West Ross) continues south as Andrews Street (40 ft), centrelines offset about 15 px. West Ross and East Ross Avenues meet Carthage Avenue offset about 26 px, recorded separately. Unnamed avenue at y about 2090 (only AVE. printed, about 30 ft wide) runs from about x 8500 to Carthage Avenue. Unnamed east stubs off Carthage Avenue, cut by the plate edge: at (9676,500) name begins O; at (9581,941) name begins C; at (9556,2729) a 60 ft stub heading east-north-east, no name; at (9552,2810) a 72 ft street heading east, name begins W, and at the same junction an AVE. continues due south (centre x about 9547) while Carthage Avenue with the car line turns south-west. At (8526,3711): stub heading south-east, name begins C. At (7865,4357): stub heading south-east, name begins B, offset about 40 px from Lawrence Street. At (7432,4964): stub east, name begins O. At (7154,6154): stub east, no name visible. At (6990,6955): a street with car track and 16 in. water pipe runs west-north-west along the bottom edge and a stub (name begins C) runs east-north-east; a street labelled ST. continues south, plate edge. The diagonal road from (9552,2800) south-west and south to the bottom edge is taken as Carthage Avenue (label CARTHAGE printed near 7100,6300). Phillips Avenue/Canal Street is an L corner. Martin/Lawrence: Lawrence Street jogs, north leg centre x 7654, south leg x 7700. The grey band north of Phillips Avenue is the old canal strip, not a street. A 10 ft alley at x about 9260 between West Ross and the unnamed avenue is not recorded.
